history.summary: A 1BR in a well-regarded D03 Tiong Bahru development (550m to MRT, city-fringe) at $1190k / $2352 psf — roughly 9% below the $2596 project median, with a reliable 4.6% CAGR over 99 transactions. Strong location fundamentals; the constraint is that it is a high-PSF shoebox.
history.rating_rationale: Tiong Bahru is one of the most resilient city-fringe rental and resale locations in RCR. $2352 psf is ~9% under the $2596 median (real discount), the 4.6% appreciation is reliable (99 txns), and the $1.19M quantum is liquid. Downside: 1BR shoebox at $2352 psf is a high absolute PSF, so the buyer pool is investor-led, and yield must justify the price. Location quality plus the below-median entry carry it to a Buy.
red_flags: High PSF ($2352) for a 506sqft shoebox — investor-only buyer pool
1BR niche resale appeal versus owner-occupier units
99yr leasehold (2018) — fine for now but not freehold
catalysts: Tiong Bahru city-fringe — strong, durable rental/resale demand near CBD
